description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Awoken Ice], [Damage Cap +10000], [100% Critical] to the user, grants [Dualcast Ice 1]/[Dualcast Ice 3] to the user if 0-3/4+ FF6 allies are alive

description.name: Awoken Ice
description.text: Ice abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice abilities trigger 1 additional time
